Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg, EDSA corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon CiW LEGAL SERVICE DILG OPINION NO. 38 S. 2010 March 31 r 2010 MR. ARNEL C. IMPERIAL Sangguniang Bayan Member Quezon, Quezon Dear Mr. Imperial: This pertains to your letter seeking our legal opinion regarding the memorandum issued by your Municipal Mayor requiring all Sangguniang Bayan Members to secure a request for authority to travel from his office before leaving their office/station and perform official function outside the municipality. In reply thereto, please be informed tnat we had already an occasion to answer a similar query in DILG Opinion No. 56 series of 2008, dated July 22, 2008. Attached herewith is a photocopy of DILG Opinion No. 56, series of 2008 for your ready perusal. We hope this settles your concern. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: ATTY. JESUS B. DOQUE IV Director III Legal: 94: ins
